name: GET /health - API liveness probe
description: Public liveness probe used by Docker health checks, load balancers and the ProjexLight test runner. Returns success:true with status 'ok' and an ISO timestamp. The API validates its environment at startup and refuses to start when a required secret or setting is missing or invalid (fail closed), so a 200 proves the running API has a complete, valid environment (feature criterion: Environment, secrets and local models are configured by script). It does not prove which tool wrote server/.env; scripts/setup-env.sh and scripts/pull-models.sh are covered by server/tests/unit/scripts. Requires no authentication and returns no tenant data. No error cases: the handler has no failure branch.

testCases.name: API is up and reports ok
